records.label: Synthetic speech generated with Google Cloud Text-to-Speech. Not a human or native-speaker recording, and must not be described as one (spec §6.1).
records.source: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech API v1, voice de-DE-Wavenet-G (WaveNet, female, de-DE), plain-text input from each audio record's spokenText, no SSML or pronunciation overrides. LINEAR16 masters at the voice's natural 24 kHz, speaking rate 1.0; trimmed (100 ms lead, 150 ms tail kept), normalized to -18 LUFS integrated with true peak at or below -1 dBTP, delivered as mono AAC-LC 48 kbps M4A (encoder: macOS afconvert). Settings: tools/tts/tts-settings.json.
